The '''Talisman of the Eollu''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Talisman of Transformation]]. It granted its wearer the power to [[Metamorphosis|turn into]] an [[eollu]]. In ''[[Wild Power]]'', [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] made a passing mention of this talisman.<ref name="BoS" />
